notes: The report opens «وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ» and takes over the chain of prev1 up to the name it writes itself (Ahmad b. Abi Abd Allah): the first two links are inherited.
«أخيه الحسين» is one link written as the name alone (rule 7); «عن أبيه» is a bare relation.
«أبي الحسن الأول» after «عن» is a narrator (owner ruling 2).
The context gives this report and prev1 the same number (293); not a chain problem, noted only.
